text: Ok who is still missing from last night. Hayley ur not answering
I got home around 2 I think. Cab from the lansdowne, driver had opinions about the roosters
Home. Dont remember how
Rude. Who was sick. I know it wasnt me
Dylan was sick in the bin outside the lansdowne I saw it
That was not me
It was you mate, you had the yellow jacket on
Sorry phone died at 11. Im alive. Slept at priya's in newtown, dont ask about the couch
THANK GOD
Ok so what do we actually remember. I remember the tequila thing and then nothing until the chips
The tequila thing was your idea
It was not
It was a bit sophie 😂
I remember you telling the bouncer his tie was a crime
I dont think that happened. But also I'm glad someone's keeping track
Anyone know if the lansdowne still has our tab open or do we owe them
[photo: bar tab screenshot]
It was split. Liam you paid the first round so youre owed like $12
Bet
That's a lot of u12s coaching for a saturday, im dead
Ok next one. Not a tuesday, we are too old for tuesdays now
Sat 12? I'm off that night
Can do. Somewhere with no tequila
No promises
Maybe for the 12th. Saturdays are rugby till like 4 but I can come after
Good enough
Transferred you the 12 hayley
Legend. Got it
Still not convinced it was me
It was you. Ask the bouncer
He wasnt there, he was on the door at the other place
The client who wanted 20% off a 3 year contract just asked if we could do "a bit more" on the discount AND throw in a free trial on the same terms. So. No. 😤
Oof. Did you say no or did you say no nicely
Said "let me check with my manager" which is code for no
Classic
PR still open from last week. Going to pretend I didnt see Sophie's text so I can keep working
Rude. I'm on my lunch
Mini rugby done. A 9 year old asked if I'd been to the Olympics. Said no. He looked gutted
Tell him you were a reserve once
Not gonna lie to a kid
Emergency shift tonight, dog ate a sock and a plastic bag. Dont ask how
How
Dont ask
Anyone out tonight or is it everyone on the couch
Couch. Wrote a bit of code and now I need to go to bed
Rugby social at the club, I'm on the sausage sizzle tomorrow so no
Pushed a change to the booking thing at 1am. It did not like the timezone handling
Lol how bad
Bad enough that I was up at 6 fixing it. Nobody books at 6am so it's fine
The 6am booking rush is brutal
Dog is fine. Sock is not. Vet bill is the real damage
How is the dog
Happy. Hungry. Pretending last night didnt happen
Morning. Sausage sizzle is 8 til 1 if anyone wants to come feed a bunch of 9 year olds' parents
No thanks, im still recovering from the tie bouncer
That didnt happen
[photo: tray of sausages on a bbq, someone's thumb in the corner]
Is that a thumb
Its Gary's. He's fine
Ok so for the 12th. Anywhere in newtown or are we going east
Newtown. Not the lansdowne
Obviously not the lansdowne
Newtown is fine. Priya will want to come if she hears so tell me now if thats a no
Its not a no. But we are talking about 5 of us now
Ok 4 of us then. Priya says she's annoyed she missed the tequila thing
Done. Gary has been returned to his mum. Everyone is still alive
Congrats on the sausages
Congrats on the sausages being cooked with no food poisoning in a park
Lansdowne emailed about the tab. The $12 that I paid. They say it went through twice
Oh no. Did you get the $12 back
Nope. Told them to keep it as a tip for the bouncer
The bouncer is getting 12 bucks from us for the tie comment
Ok home from the client dinner. The one who wanted 20% off got the 20% and I feel gross about it. Anyway im going to bed
You're allowed to feel gross. Also, free trial?
No trial 😤
Good. Im asleep on the couch, the dog has claimed my feet
Pushed a fix at 11:45 pm for the timezone thing. It's fine now. If the booking page breaks at 6am again I'm moving to a farm
